testCases.title: Verify whether cookies popup is getting displayed when user launch the application

stepResults.action: Launch the browser. Browser = Chrome
Enter URL and launch the application. URL = https://accounts.creatio.com/login/alm
Verify whether Cookies popup is getting displayed
stepResults.expectedResult: cookies pop-up should get displayed before the login page to take the consent from the user.
stepResults.remarks: Cookies pop-up (#CybotCookiebotDialog) is displayed before login.

testCases.title: Verify Cookies Consent message displayed in the Cookies popup

stepResults.action: Launch the browser. Browser = Chrome
Enter URL and launch the application. URL = https://accounts.creatio.com/login/alm
Verify whether Cookies popup is getting displayed
stepResults.expectedResult: cookies pop-up should get displayed before the login page to take the consent from the user.
stepResults.remarks: Cookies pop-up (#CybotCookiebotDialog) is displayed before login.

stepResults.action: Verify Cookies Consent message displayed in the Cookies popup
stepResults.expectedResult: consent message should be displayed as below "This website uses cookiesWe may use cookies and similar technologies to collect information about the ways you interact with and use the website, to support and enhance features and functionality, to monitor performance, to personalize content and experiences, for marketing and analytics, and for other lawful purposes. We also may share information about your use of our site with our social media, advertising and analytics partners who may combine it with other information that you’ve provided to them or that they’ve collected from your use of their services. Please, see more details on the "About" tab "
stepResults.remarks: Consent message verified: header and policy description are displayed.
